title: Predictive modelling of hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy risk following perinatal asphyxia.
summary: clinical variables from a prospective cohort of infants with perinatal asphyxia were split into training/validation and an independent test set; random forest with 5-fold CV predicted subsequent HIE. This is a bounded clinical risk-prediction study; it does not establish improved cooling outcomes.
